Dick Taverne, Baron Taverne (18 October 1928 – 25 October 2025) was a British politician and life peer who served as Member of Parliament (MP) for Lincoln from 1962 to 1974. [ 1 ] A member of the Liberal Democrats , he was a Labour MP until his deselection in 1972, [ 2 ] following which he resigned his seat and won the subsequent by-election in 1973 as a Democratic Labour candidate. [ 3 ]
